svg.aria-label: One run: learn six worlds, play three remixes, return to five; the way into every battle is a mechanic an earlier battle made you use
svg.text: 14 battles in order against the same bot, by one player that is never reset. Under each: the way in, which the battle itself never says.
Battle 1 shows the middle's meter. Battles 2 and 3 start you inside a ring, with a portal and then a switch as the only way out.
After that nothing is explained: the way in is always something you had to use before.
